atom_retention.B_factor: Preserve B_iso_or_equiv, including distinct missing tokens; finite nonnegative when supplied. No uncertainty estimate or exclusion based on B factors.
atom_retention.element: Exclude H and D by type_symbol, not atom-name prefix. Retain original element. Unknown/missing elements fail validation; no atom-name inference.
atom_retention.exclusion_ledger: Record full source atom identity, original row values and every reason. Nonprotein rows are excluded from receptor set; W0O is used only as the query ligand at its own site. primary_exclusions.csv is this distinction, not a claim W0O never enters a distance.
atom_retention.ligand_completeness: For each ligand conformer, require exactly all 30 CCD heavy-atom names/elements at positive occupancy. A missing/excluded atom gives retained site/conformer refusal with null numerical output; never calculate a misleading complete-ligand minimum. Keep excluded H/D explicit, but absence of CCD H does not cause heavy-atom incompleteness.
atom_retention.occupancy: Required finite numeric 0<=occupancy<=1. Exclude 0 with full row/reason. Retain 0<occupancy<1 with a flag at atom, pair, residue and site levels; never weight distances by occupancy. No missing occupancy default to 1.

conformers.actual_data: 8RIY: all altloc .; four positive fractional atoms on R51 across AAA/BBB plus AAA R51 CZ occupancy 0. 8OTV: only B/auth47 LEU (label48) has A/B, eight heavy atoms each at 0.50; every W0O atom has . and occupancy 1.
conformers.blank_dot: Raw . means no alternate label. It is included as shared atoms in each explicitly labeled local conformer. A blank and nonblank row for the same atom name in one local conformer is ambiguous and refused, not overwritten.
conformers.definition: Within a residue/site/model, if no nonblank altloc exists use the sole . conformer; otherwise one separate conformer per nonblank label, each union its own label plus unambiguous shared . atoms. Never average or union A/B alternatives into one atom set.
conformers.pairing: Current W0O ligands have no alternatives. Compare each . ligand with every local protein conformer separately. If only ligand has alternatives, each is separately compared with a . protein residue. If BOTH ligand and residue have nonblank alternatives, pairwise compatibility is unsupported in v1: retain conformer records and refuse paired numeric distances unless a separately versioned, primary-supported correlation policy is provided. Do not infer A-A compatibility across residues or enumerate joint conformations as if observed.
conformers.site_summary: No single pooled site contact count across mutually incompatible local alternatives. Present per-residue/conformer map and retain alternate rows even outside all four radii.
conformers.unknown_question_mark: Raw ? for atom_site.label_alt_id is unknown, not silently blank; retain affected site/residue with unknown_altloc refusal. In insertion-code fields, preserve ? as deposited unspecified insertion, not a new residue or numeric zero.

estimand.computation: IEEE-754 float64 Euclidean distance on deposited Cartesian A coordinates; no preprocessing, rounding, minimization, protonation, occupancy weighting, superposition or normalization before comparison. Nonfinite arithmetic fails.
estimand.definition: For each deposited site/model, each eligible ligand conformer, and each local protein residue conformer on BOTH official dimer members, d=min sqrt((Lx-Px)^2+(Ly-Py)^2+(Lz-Pz)^2) over the retained atom sets. Preserve the minimum witness pair(s) and all atom pairs at <=5.0 A. Do not infer chemical interaction type.
estimand.name: minimum_observed_heavy_atom_ligand_to_protein_residue_distance
estimand.presentation: Keep full numerical precision in JSON; if rounded for display, do not recompute bins and annotate that coordinate/model uncertainty is not propagated.
estimand.radius_meaning: fixed descriptive proximity convention, not chemistry/affinity/energy threshold
estimand.ties: All atom pairs whose computed distance exactly equals the computed minimum; deterministic atom-ID ordering. No outcome-dependent epsilon.

forbidden_outputs: new inhibitor or first Arg51 rationale

missingness.completeness_limit: No-deposited-missingness flag is not density certainty or independent proof that every protein atom was modeled. Do not manufacture missing atoms/loops or add CCD ideal/model coordinates to a deposit.
missingness.partial_residue: If positive-occupancy atoms remain, compute only observed minimum with status=partial_observed; list every declared missing/zero atom and keep complete_residue_distance=null. A within-radius observed pair is descriptive evidence of modeled proximity; a larger observed minimum cannot exclude closer absent atoms.
missingness.unobserved_residue: Retain row with distance=null, threshold flags=null, reason=unobserved_residue. Do not substitute infinity/zero or conclude no contact.
missingness.unspecified_missing_atom_altloc: A missingness row with altloc ? flags every local conformer of that residue as potentially incomplete; it does not invent or select a conformer.
missingness.whole_site: All four real sites retain complete_site_geometry_status=refused for complete-pocket geometry because dimer residues/atoms are missing. Observed-coordinate maps remain eligible. Site complete_geometry_refusal_reason must accompany each map. This is not a refusal of every usable coordinate pair.
missingness.zero_only_residue: If no eligible protein heavy atoms remain, distance=null and reason=no_eligible_protein_atoms.

output.atomic_publication: Require existing output parent. Reject existing path including empty file, directory and dangling symlink. Serialize entirely before staging; write same-directory temp, flush+fsync, hardlink to new destination (no overwrite), remove staging in finally. Concurrent writers: only one succeeds. Never overwrite or partially publish.
output.complete_residue_distance_status: Always not_estimated in v1, including unflagged residues: primary estimand is observed geometry, not complete biological geometry. complete_residue_distance_A=null.

exit_codes.0: valid report atomically written, possibly with refusals
exit_codes.2: invalid package, parse/validation/computation/output failure; no result published

output.format: Single strict JSON result, allow_nan=False; no generated CSV/PDF required
output.provenance: Record exact command/absolute resolved inputs, source/contract/code/dependency hashes, parser/Python/numerical versions, actual UTC time, actual Git revision/worktree state. Keep numerical data deterministic independent of input row order. Do not rewrite old manifests after commits.
output.sorting: Sort entry, model ID, site full identity, ligand conformer, protein label_asym_id, integer label_seq_id, insertion token, component, protein conformer, then atom full identity lexicographically; never rely on source loop order.
output.threshold_values: Boolean only for eligible observed minimum; null on refusal. False means no retained observed pair at that radius, never a missing-geometry no-contact claim.

parser_requirement: Mature CIF parser, no homemade parser. Gemmi 0.7.3 generic CIF DOM was verified for inspection only in isolated target with archived official docs/PyPI metadata and hash/audit. Implementer must reverify version/API/advisories and lock runtime dependency if adopted without changing root package pins. High-level parsers that silently select disorder/first model/author-chain conventions are unacceptable.

scope.assembly: Official assembly 1 is identity operation 1 over all ASU members in both structures. Keep protein label chains A and B for EVERY site. Validate matrix and translation before use; no extra symmetry copies or lattice contacts. Unsupported nonidentity/multiple assembly policy retains site with assembly refusal, not a one-chain fallback.
scope.independence: Four crystal sites are descriptive copies, not biological n. No CI, p-value, bootstrap, SEM, population SD or averaged target-level distance claimed as independent evidence.
scope.models: Enumerate all deposited model IDs and all W0O sites; fixed source package expects model 1 only. Changed content needs a separately versioned input package, never best-model selection.
scope.other_entities: Water, ions, DMS, other W0O sites and any nonprotein polymer are not protein receptor atoms. Inventory all separately. Do not add water-mediated contacts or compare absence of metal as an energetic effect.
scope.protein_membership: Resolve _struct_asym.entity_id -> _entity.type=polymer and _entity_poly.type=polypeptide(L); do not classify by ATOM/HETATM alone. Require expected entity 1, label A/B and auth-chain mappings.
scope.residue_correspondence: None inferred. Report two target-specific maps. R51/NUDT5 and L107/NUDT14 are paper-assigned ligand-region environments, not sequence-homologous residues. No optional RMSD/superposition in v1.
scope.residue_universe: All _pdbx_poly_seq_scheme rows on both protein chains per model/site, including unobserved residues; label_seq_id is the sequence key, not auth_seq_id. Retain label/auth identities and insertion codes.

validation.accepted_CIF_nulls: Preserve raw . and ? distinctly; semantic null handling is field-specific. W0O label_seq_id=. is expected nonpolymer not a parser failure. Missing author residue numbers in unobserved _pdbx_poly_seq_scheme rows are preserved and recovered only through explicit deposited cross-reference, never by guessing.
validation.known_valid_missingness: Missing residues/atoms declared in deposited categories, zero occupancy, fractional occupancy and explicit alternate conformers are retained scientific limitations, not silently discarded package errors. Known complete-ligand refusal states are tested with separately hash-consistent synthetic inputs, not by bypassing real-input hashes.
validation.optional_columns: Preserve additional source fields verbatim without interpreting them (e.g. 8RIY calc_flag); unknown metadata does not authorize relaxed required-field validation.
order: Validate manifest JSON structure, required keys, unknown keys, duplicate keys and hashes
Parse all mmCIF with mature parser and strict syntax checks; validate categories and cross-record invariants
Determine exclusions/conformers/refusals for all sites and residues
Atomically publish a new result or leave no result
package_errors: duplicate JSON keys; NaN/Inf; unknown manifest/contract fields; Boolean in numeric field
path traversal, absolute artifact path, symlink escape, symlink input/output or missing input; changed hash; mismatched entry ID
empty/malformed/multiple CIF blocks; duplicate tags; ragged/empty mandatory loops; missing mandatory categories/columns
duplicate atom_site.id or duplicate full atom identity (including model/asym/seq/component/insertion/atom/altloc)
nonfinite/nonnumeric coordinates or occupancy; occupancy outside [0,1]; missing element; inconsistent atom name/element against W0O CCD
unresolved entity/chain/sequence joins; mismatched label/auth mapping; protein residue present and also declared wholly unobserved; flag0 zero-atom ledger contradicts positive atom occupancy
silently missing/unexpected W0O site or model relative to manifest; undisclosed source version; inconsistent target/species/construct/assembly metadata
